senses.gloss: to break clods and level the ground; to break ground; to till.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 85b:15">Men. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>היה עוֹזֵק תחת זיתיו</he> (cmp. <cite ref="B00916"><he>בָּלַשׁ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 962">Yalk. Deut. 962</cite> <he>עוסק</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 950">Yalk. Prov. 950</cite> <he>מוסק</he>) was hacking and levelling the ground under his olive trees. Ohol. XVIII, 5 <he>העוזק בית הפרס</he> he who breaks a field suspected of containing human bones (v. <cite ref="Q01911"><he>פְּרָס</he></cite>). Tosef. ib. XVII, 9 <he>עֲזָקוֹ אין לך בדיקה וכ׳</he> if he broke the ground, there is no better way of examining than this.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:3:1">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite> top (ref. to <he>בית יעזק</he>, v. <cite ref="J00481"><he>יַעְזֵק</he></cite>) <he>ששם היו עוֹזְקִין את ההלכה</he> for there they cultivated (levelled) the law; a. e.
<cite ref="Chullin 94a">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>עוזק אחת בפיו וכ׳</he> holding one piece in his mouth and two in his hands.
